name: Berke Şen
bio: Berke Şen is a Turkish filmmaker. He has worked as a director, cinematographer, and editor on short films and documentaries. His latest short film, EKEKEKEK (2026), is a dark comedy exploring grief, guilt, and letting go through an absurd everyday situation. His work focuses on atmosphere, human psychology, and blending genre elements with unconventional storytelling.

credits.title: EKEKEKEK
credits.overview: A man who is forced to kill his cat after it suddenly transforms into a creature tries to give it a proper farewell by burying the body with his friend.
